gloss: to let die out; to use up; to run out of

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {絶|た}やしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to let die out; to extinguish; to discontinue
definitions.explanation: To allow something to come to an end or cease to exist, often through neglect or inaction. Used for traditions, lineages, fires, and other things that can be maintained or lost.

definitions.gloss: to run out of; to use up the supply of
definitions.explanation: To use up or fail to maintain a stock of something. Often used in the negative form to mean keeping a constant supply.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}やして⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: We must not let the tradition die out.
I added firewood so the fire wouldn't go out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先祖|せんぞ}→先祖：04040_senzo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{家系|かけい}→家系：10130_kakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}やさないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{跡継|あとつ}ぎ→跡継ぎ：14299_atotsugi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: They are looking for a successor so as not to let the family line that has continued from their ancestors die out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}やさない。
⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}やさず⟦{飾|かざ}っている→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: She always keeps flowers on display without letting them run out.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}えない→絶える：13814_taeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: That restaurant always has a steady stream of customers, so you can't get in without a reservation.
examples.notes: Uses the intransitive form {絶|た}えない.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {絶|た}やす is transitive. The intransitive counterpart is ⟦{絶|た}える→絶える：13814_taeru⟧ (to cease, to die out).

ASPECT (て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧): {絶|た}やして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing state of having let something lapse.

NEGATIVE FORM: Very frequently used in the negative ({絶|た}やさない) to express maintaining something continuously: ⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}やさない (to always keep smiling).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}やす (to let something die out)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}やさない: to always keep smiling
- ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}やさない: to keep the fire going
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}やす: to let a tradition die out
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}やさない: to always have flowers (on display)
